t: Browser tools for live coding visuals, inspired by analog video synthesizers.
steps: Open hydra.ojack.xyz in Chrome or Chromium.
Try the example code that loads on the page.
Change a number in a line and run it again.
Check that the computer has WebGL.
Allow a webcam only after reviewing school policy.
Ask IT about local hosting with Node.js and Yarn.
Review the workshop slides by Zach Krall.
